images.filename: StateLibQld 1 54544 Panoramic view of the Gas Works on Beesley Street, South Brisbane 1935.jpg
images.caption:
Panoramic view of the Gas Works on Beesley Street, South Brisbane 1935.
The elongated view is accompanied by an engineering drawing of the site adjacent to the Brisbane River. The stripping tower near the centre of the photograph is now a heritage listed item, re-erected outside Davies Park.
